top_band: light slate blue roof slopes on both upper tower (rows 8-17) and lower base (rows 52-61)
evidence: Both the upper cabin and lower base show 10-row sloped/horizontal top roof bands (rows 8-17 and 52-61) with lighter front-edge highlights (rows 15-16, 61) and dark eave bands (rows 18, 62-63) above recessed windows and doors.

style.evidence: The candidate relies on large flat fills of solid grey/blue across the upper roof (rows 8-14), central shaft (rows 32-52), lower roof panels, and dark lower walls (rows 66-76), outlined with a thick near-black border. Compared to the Beodeul reference houses with intricate per-tile roof shading, speckled plaster, and individually shaded stones, this piece has much lower texture and information density.
